records.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
records.agency: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
records.benefitSummary: Collateral-free institutional credit for eligible non-corporate, non-farm micro enterprises. Standard PMMY categories run up to ₹10 lakh; Tarun Plus up to ₹20 lakh has an additional prior-repayment condition.
records.description: Supports eligible micro enterprises in manufacturing, trading, services and activities allied to agriculture through participating lenders.
records.conditionalBenefit: Tarun Plus: above ₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh only for entrepreneurs who have previously availed and successfully repaid a Tarun loan.
records.eligibilitySummary: The business must meet the lender's PMMY eligibility and credit assessment. Tarun Plus requires successful repayment of an earlier Tarun loan.
requiredDocuments: Identity and address proof requested by the lender
PAN where required by the lender
Business plan, quotations, or other lender-requested business documents
records.applicationRoute: Apply through a participating bank, RRB, small finance bank, NBFC, MFI, or the official PMMY/JanSamarth route.

financeTerms.note: The interest rate and repayment tenure are set by the lending institution under its policy. Arthniti uses a transparent planning baseline until a lender quote is available.

provenance.source: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

records.name: PM Vishwakarma
records.agency: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
records.benefitSummary: For eligible traditional artisans and craftspeople in the notified trades: training, a toolkit incentive up to ₹15,000, and collateral-free Enterprise Development Loans up to ₹3 lakh in two conditional tranches.
records.description: End-to-end support for artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools in the notified traditional trades.
records.eligibilitySummary: Applicants must be eligible traditional artisans or craftspeople in a notified trade and complete the official verification process. Basic training is required before the first credit tranche.
requiredDocuments: Documents or verification requested through the PM Vishwakarma process
records.applicationRoute: Apply through a Common Service Centre (CSC) or the official PM Vishwakarma portal; eligibility is verified through the official process.

financeTerms.note: First credit tranche: up to ₹1 lakh after basic training. A second tranche of up to ₹2 lakh has separate conditions and is not assumed in the first-stage plan.

provenance.source: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of MSME
